title: 第十章 打更人的遗产
slug: 这个文字冒险游戏绝对有毒
content_zh:
【“打更人房间的结界很特殊，只有在每天上午的九点至十二点钟内才能’！”】
沐游心说这是什么‘暴力破门’暗号，一边默默的按下了怀表。
【时光流转，你损失的五十年寿命恢复完全，重回了上个选项之前。】
【稻草人眼中依然在闪动着贪婪的光芒，用诱惑的声音询问你：“是否立即支付50年寿命，得到开锁的……”】
“否！”
稻草人：？？？
【你打断了稻草人的提议，稻草人纽扣眼中的兴奋变成了疑惑：“冒险者，你确定不需要购买开锁方法吗？现在购买只需要四十年寿命哦！冒险者，我知道你已经动心了，那么，心动不如行……”】
“我说了‘否’！”
【你再次坚定的选择了否，又一次打断了稻草人的推销。】
【你看到稻草人额头隐约开始冒汗了，它强行挤出了一个干笑：“好吧冒险者，我再退一步，只需要三十年寿命，我就可以告诉你开锁方法。另外，我必须要郑重的提醒你，如果没有我的开锁方法，任何人都无法进入打更人家中，没错，是任何人！你最好考虑清……”】
“呵呵，我明天再来。”
沐游这次点选了否之后，又点选了下一级菜单的‘直接离开’。
【你在稻草人幽怨的目光中，离开了村口，朝着村庄内部走去。】
【安宁村中的道路曲折复杂，初次到来的你，并不熟悉村庄里的建筑布局。你的面前出现了三条道路，分别通往东西南三个方向，你选择前往？】
三个选项【东】【南】【西】。
打更人的住所在村庄的东头，这里肯定要选择往东走。
不过沐游没有直接选东，而是先尝试了一下其他两条路。
【你选择了前往西边的道路。】
【往前走出一段后，一座食堂出现在你眼前。】
【这是村庄厨师开的餐厅，里面售卖一些简单的魔法食物，可以补充你的魔力和体力，如果你饿了，可以进去吃点东西——前提是你肯付寿命。】

一座可以补充魔力和体力的食堂，这里的‘体力’，沐游估计是指行动力，也就是说，游戏中的行动力果然可以靠其他手段回复。
不过就算如此，沐游也肯定不会进这里面吃东西，毕竟魔力和行动力都是可以靠时间恢复的玩意儿，专门氪命恢复，怎么想都不划算。
【你回溯了时间，重回了刚才的路口。】
【这次你选择了走南边的路。】
【往前走出一段后，你看到一间撒散发着蒸汽的铁炉堡，矗立在前方的雪地中。这是一个大胡子矮人开的铁匠铺。醉心于锻造的矮人一族，拥有高超的铸造手艺，如果你有想要打造的装备，可以带着原料来这里，即便是废铁，矮人铁匠也可以帮你变废为宝——当然，前提是你肯支付寿命！】
“所以村口西边是补充行动力的食堂，南边是打造装备的铁匠铺。”
沐游一边按动怀表，回溯了时间，一边找来一张白纸，在纸上将村口、食堂、铁匠铺三个地点的相对位置画了出来。
这个村子看样子是完全按照现实中的小镇来设计的，既然有食堂和铁匠铺，那么肯定就还有其他各种满足衣食住行的店铺。
不过让沐游头疼的是，这游戏玩了两天，目前他遇到的所有选项都在消耗他的寿命，被杀要掉寿命，买东西要寿命，就连问问题也要支付寿命……
这个世界，寿命似乎就是最基础的货币。
问题在于——他至今没有找到任何一种提升寿命的手段！
哪怕他的时光怀表能够大大减缓他寿命消耗的速度，这么只出不进之下，也迟早有浪完的一天……
不管如何，寿命这种问题在现实中肯定是无解的，也只能在游戏中想办法了。沐游摇了摇头，继续游戏。
【时光回溯，你又一次回到了村头的路口。】
【这次，你选择了走向东边的小路。】
【你沿着村庄的外围，一路向东探索了多时，终于来到了村庄的东头。】
【这里已经接近村庄的边缘，附近人迹罕至，只有一间破败的木屋，孤独的竖立在前方的树丛中。由于木屋的主人已经死亡，它现在变成了一间无主的小木屋。】
【是否进入‘打更人的小木屋？’】
居然一次就到了！
看来村庄大门距离村庄东头不远。

沐游先尝试了一下点击‘进入’。
【你走到木屋的正门前，想要推门而入，却被木屋的结界所弹开。】
【木屋的大门上，一张扭曲狰狞的南瓜脸悄然浮现，它瞪着你说：“除了房间的主人，任何陌生人想要进入木屋，都必须要在正确的时间，说出正确的暗号！”】
文本下方紧接着又弹出了一个输入框。
“这还是面部识别和密码双重解锁功能啊……”
沐游感慨了一下这个‘魔法锁’的神奇，抬头看了眼时间。
上午9点12分。
根据稻草人的说法，这木屋必须在每天上午的九点到十二点之间才能开启，如果两个世界的时间是对应的话，现在倒是刚好符合要求。
沐游在文本框中输入了‘不给开门就戳瞎你眼’，点击发送。
【你说出了正确的暗号，南瓜脸在一阵扭曲中消失，尘封的大门缓缓向你
“这么说两个世界的时间果然是对应的吗？”
沐游点了点头，点击‘进入’。
【你进入了打更人的小木屋。】
【这是一间柏木筑造的屋子。因为闲置已久，屋内的空气中充斥着一种木头腐败发霉的气味，地上和仅有的几件家具上，覆盖着一层纤薄的灰尘。窗户和门板显露着破旧阴森的色彩，看起来更像是一间鬼屋。】
【你在这破败的木屋中探索了一番，总算有所收获。】
【你获得了‘打更人的南瓜灯’一盏、‘打更背包’一个、‘打更人皮肤’一套。】
“好家伙？”
沐游眼睛一亮。
本来看到前面对小破屋的描述，他都以为没戏了，这地方怎么看都是个废弃的空房间，结果没想到还真给他搜出来了东西！
content_en:
["The enchantment in the watchman's room is very special, it can only be used between nine and twelve o'clock every morning!"]
Mu Youxin said that this was the code for 'violent break-in', and silently pressed the pocket watch.
[As time goes by, your lost fifty years of life are completely restored, and you are back to where you were before the last option. 】
[The scarecrow's eyes are still flashing with greed, and he asks you in a seductive voice: "Do you want to pay 50 years of life immediately and get the lock opener..."]
"No!"
Scarecrow:? ? ?
[You interrupted the Scarecrow’s proposal, and the excitement in Scarecrow’s button eyes turned into confusion: “Adventurer, are you sure you don’t need to buy a lock-picking method? Buying it now only requires forty years of life! Adventurer, I know you are already tempted, so it’s better to just do it...”]
"I said 'no'!"
[You firmly chose No again, interrupting the Scarecrow’s sales pitch again. 】
[You saw the scarecrow began to sweat faintly on its forehead, and it forced out a dry smile: "Okay adventurer, I will take a step back. It only takes thirty years to live, and I can tell you how to unlock the lock. In addition, I must solemnly remind you that without my unlocking method, no one can enter the house of the watchman. Yes, it is anyone! You'd better think about it..."]
"Haha, I'll come back tomorrow."
After Muyou clicked No this time, he clicked 'Leave directly' on the next level menu.
[Under the Scarecrow’s resentful gaze, you left the entrance of the village and walked towards the interior of the village. 】
[The roads in Anning Village are winding and complicated. When you arrive for the first time, you are not familiar with the architectural layout of the village. Three roads appear in front of you, leading to the east, west, and south. Which direction do you choose? 】
Three options [East] [South] [West].
The watchman's residence is at the east end of the village, so you must choose to go east here.
However, Mu You did not choose Dong directly, but tried the other two paths first.
[You chose the road to the west. 】
[After walking forward for a while, a canteen appears in front of you. 】
[This is a restaurant opened by the village chef. It sells some simple magic food, which can replenish your magic power and physical strength. If you are hungry, you can go in and eat something - provided you are willing to pay for your lifespan. 】
A canteen that can replenish magic power and physical strength. The "physical strength" here, Mu You probably refers to mobility. In other words, mobility in the game can indeed be restored by other means.
But even so, Mu You would definitely not go in here to eat. After all, magic power and mobility are things that can be recovered by time. It is not worthwhile to focus on life recovery.
[You went back in time and returned to the intersection just now. 】
[This time you chose to take the south road. 】
[After walking forward for a while, you see an Ironforge emitting steam, standing in the snow in front of you. This is a blacksmith shop run by a bearded dwarf. The dwarves are obsessed with forging and have superb casting skills. If you have equipment you want to build, you can bring the raw materials here. Even if it is scrap iron, the dwarf blacksmith can help you turn waste into treasure - of course, provided you are willing to pay for your lifespan! 】
"So to the west of the village entrance is the canteen to supplement mobility, and to the south is the blacksmith shop for making equipment."
Mu You pressed his pocket watch and retraced the time. He found a piece of white paper and drew the relative positions of the village entrance, canteen and blacksmith shop on the paper.
This village seems to be designed exactly like a real town. Since there is a canteen and a blacksmith shop, there must be various other shops that meet the daily necessities of life.
But what troubles Mu You is that after playing this game for two days, all the options he has encountered are consuming his lifespan. Being killed requires lifespan, buying things requires lifespan, and even asking questions requires paying lifespan...
this world,Lifespan seems to be the most basic currency.
The problem is - he hasn't found any way to extend his lifespan so far!
Even if his time pocket watch can greatly slow down the consumption of his lifespan, sooner or later he will run out of time...
No matter what, the problem of lifespan is definitely unsolvable in reality, and we can only find a solution in the game. Mu You shook his head and continued the game.
[Looking back in time, you are back at the intersection at the head of the village again. 】
[This time, you chose the path to the east. 】
[You have been exploring eastward along the periphery of the village for a long time, and finally arrived at the east end of the village. 】
[This place is close to the edge of the village. There are few people nearby. There is only a dilapidated wooden house standing alone among the trees in front. Since the owner of the cabin has died, it is now an ownerless cabin. 】
【Do you want to enter the watchman’s cabin? ’]
It actually arrived in one go!
It seems that the village gate is not far from the east end of the village.
Mu You tried it first and clicked 'Enter'.
[You walk to the front door of the wooden house and want to push the door open, but are bounced away by the barrier of the wooden house. 】
[On the door of the wooden house, a twisted and ferocious pumpkin face quietly appears. It stares at you and says: "Except for the owner of the room, any stranger who wants to enter the wooden house must speak the correct code at the right time!"]
Another input box pops up immediately below the text.
"This is also a dual unlocking function with facial recognition and password..."
Mu You sighed at the magic of this 'magic lock' and looked up at the time.
9:12 am.
According to the Scarecrow, this wooden house must be opened between nine and twelve o'clock every morning. If the time in the two worlds corresponds, now it just meets the requirements.
Muyou entered 'I'll poke your eyes out if you don't open the door' in the text box and clicked send.
[You said the correct password, the pumpkin face disappeared in a burst of distortion, and the dust-covered door slowly came towards you
"So the time in the two worlds really corresponds?"
Mu You nodded and clicked 'Enter'.
[You enter the watchman's cabin. 】
[This is a house made of cypress wood. Because it had been idle for a long time, the air inside the house was filled with the smell of rotting and moldy wood. The floor and the few pieces of furniture were covered with a thin layer of dust. The windows and door panels showed a dilapidated and eerie color, making it look more like a haunted house. 】
[You explored this dilapidated wooden house and finally gained something. 】
[You have obtained a ‘Watchman’s Pumpkin’ Lantern’, a ‘Watchman’s Backpack’, and a set of ‘Watchman’s Skin’. 】
"Good guy?"
Mu You's eyes lit up.
When he saw the previous description of the small shabby house, he thought it was all hopeless. This place looked like an abandoned empty room, but to his surprise, he actually found something!
